note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Both scenes share every fact except whether the original itself is opened. Fictional works and references; no judgement on either way of citing.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Same note 12, same treatise at p. 88, same cited entry 3 of fol. 14. A opens the archive box, lifts the original and the chain reaches its entry; B keeps the box closed and records the source as cited in the treatise.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional trail (a review note citing a commentary, which cites entry 2 of a town council register) with different scenario wording and shared facts.

scenarioA.label: Register consulted
scenarioA.caption: The register itself is taken out and read at entry 2

scenarioB.label: Cited through the commentary
scenarioB.caption: The register stays boxed; its entry is taken from the commentary

params.changedFact: Only one fact differs: whether the register itself is opened

comparisonLabels.guide: Changed fact: which document is read last
comparisonLabels.neutral: Both scenes show a way of recording the reference — neither is ranked

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long work titles, long scenario labels and captions, a long changed fact, four shared facts and long guide/neutral labels.
